findings.title: KeyError when integration metadata has no sender
findings.body: `integration.metadata["sender"]["login"]` assumes the installation webhook already stored `sender`. An existing Integration without that key (for example one created before the webhook was processed, or older rows) makes this raise KeyError and return a 500 instead of the error page. Use `.get("sender", {}).get("login")` and fail closed with `error(...)` when it is missing.

findings.title: Installation-not-found test no longer tests that path
findings.body: The test used to assert "The GitHub installation could not be found.". It now asserts the generic "Invalid installation request.", and it sends a different `state` (`ddd023...`) than the signature used elsewhere. The request likely fails at the state check, so the 404 handling in `build_integration` is never reached. Use the correct state and keep asserting the installation-not-found message.
